(iii) If there is planet in the 4th or 8th from the dasa
lord and none in the other stipulated houses, the propor-
tion will be indicated by fractions 1/1 and 1/4 which means 4 to

<math>_{\mathrm{lord.}}</math>
<math>(iv)</math> If there is a planet located in 7th from the dasa lord
and none in the other stipulated houses, the proportion as
between main and sub period lord will be 1/1 and 1/7 ie 7 to 1
or 7/8th and 1/8th respectively.
<math>(v)</math> If there is a planet with the dasa lord and also in 5th
or 9th from it but none in 4th, 8th or 7th from it, the proportion
would be <math>1/1</math>, <math>1/2</math> and <math>1/3</math> which gives 6, 3 and 2 out of 11, hence
the dasa of the three planets ie the main dasa, lord, one with
dasa lord and one in the trine to dasa lord would be 6/11th,
3/11th and 2/11th respectively of the total period of the dasa
lord.
<math>(vi)</math> If a planet is with the dasa lord and one in 4th or
8th from it, but none in trine from it then the proportion
would be indicated by fractions <math>1/1</math>, <math>1/2</math> and <math>1/4</math> ie 4, 2 and 1 or
4/7th, 2/7th and 1/7th respectively of the total period of dasa
lord.
(vii) If a planet is with the dasa lord and also one in
7th from it, but none in other stipulated house, the propor-
tion would be denoted by <math>1/1</math>, <math>1/2</math>, <math>1/7</math> ie 14, 7 and 2 or
14/23rd, 7/23rd and 2/23rd of the total period of the main dasa
lord.
(viii) If there are planets in trines from the dasa lord and
in none of the other stipulated houses the proportion would be
<math>1/1</math>, <math>1/3</math> and <math>1/3</math> ie 3, 1, 1 or <math>3/5</math>th, <math>1/5</math>th and <math>1/5</math>th respectively
for main dasa lord etc.
